source_text: Medicinally, the practice is rationalized as a curative intervention for a range of reproductive ailments beyond the core gishiri condition, including amenorrhea (absence of menstruation), pruritus vulvae (vaginal itching), and chronic pelvic pain attributed to vaginal constriction.
